description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Double Crystarium Mode (Holy, Dark)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Cid Raines], [Apex Seraphic Ray Damage Tracker] and [Apex Seraphic Ray Level]

description.name: Double Crystarium Mode (Holy, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Holy]/[Attach Dark] after using a Holy/Dark ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Cid Raines
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Seraphic Ray (0~2), removed after using Apex Seraphic Ray two times

description.name: Apex Seraphic Ray Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Seraphic Ray level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Cid Raines]

description.name: Apex Seraphic Ray Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Seraphic Ray level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Cid Raines]
